operations.contract: Parse official config paths/UNIX listeners, establish dependencies, expose service only with usable identity; activation, client permissions and controlled shutdown have defined results.
PILS address feed and HELLO-derived identity must agree with current communicator addresses; stale address-set callbacks cannot roll identity back or combine two identities in one session.
required_cases: identity replacement closes old sessions and fresh publishes

operations.contract: Retain actual identity secrets through cryptographic operations; old async signing/decapsulation belongs to its original epoch; key release follows owned work retirement.
All monotonic replay namespaces have authoritative ordering and durable anti-rollback semantics; a lost physical MQ does not prove a pending backend STORE canceled.
required_cases: scan actual END then single STORE
same peer and replay-kind competing sessions
database failure is no false ACK

operations.contract: Persist/export current signed HELLO and discover target HELLO via PEERSTORE; cancel and reconnect monitors without applying stale peer/epoch results.
required_cases: target-specific suggestion cannot enumerate unrelated targets

operations.contract: Address scope, NAT registration/reversal, canonical address strings and announced validity match external transport requirements.
Exactly one initialized app gets actual self identity/class and working self MQ; required service-info is not an invented serialized field.
required_cases: PILS reidentity retires old app epoch

operations.contract: Old request timers/CAR ownership are retired before DISCONNECT; prior queued READY remains FIFO before notification, and new peer generation cannot inherit old work.
required_cases: old pending and old queued READY
partial original SEND drain after DISC
MQ loss and exact one notification

operations.contract: Peer+smr association, 16-bit wrap/backpressure, priority/deadline and remote admission have real effects; READY grants capacity, not delivery.
required_cases: cancel before/after request and partial SEND

operations.contract: Dispatch each actual inner frame to matching types/options, preserve full/header shape and source peer; empty-type/nonzero-options wildcard is explicit pinned behavior.
required_cases: both four-byte previews of larger inner frame
slow consumer queue limits and no cross-peer data

operations.contract: Independent continuous monitor emits current state/time then exact state11/zeropeer/FOREVER snapshot marker and later updates; physical loss is local, not invented server END.
required_cases: normal C public monitor initial snapshot

operations.contract: Both initiator orderings authenticate actual peer identities/classes/services and tolerate legitimate retransmission without replacing old confirmed association incorrectly.
required_cases: two deterministic role seeds with normal C
retry exhaustion and late old ACK

operations.contract: Authentic records preserve application framing; per-association epoch and replay windows advance only after valid authentication.
required_cases: valid old epoch after new epoch

operations.contract: Key update requests in both directions produce actual epoch1 records; heartbeat loss/retry, idle expiry and timer backpressure obey real time.
required_cases: both roles and both directions actual HB flags1
no artificial12h clock jump as liveness proof

operations.contract: Validate START identity/receive options and per-connection role; notify only usable confirmed links, preserving per-peer lifecycle on queue churn.
Four per-peer client send credits and explicit receive completion control actual local capacity; SEND_OK is not remote application delivery; no premature communicator ACK when CORE is stalled.
One physical communicator connection owns its advertised prefix/characteristics and address IDs; scoped address changes feed PILS and never release foreign owners.
Queue identity is scoped to original communicator and peer; address/network/MTU/reliability/length updates alter actual routing; CREATE request results cannot complete another epoch.
Original per-queue message/correlation ownership survives partial output; positive/negative completion and receive flow leases complete once.
Authenticate/promote peer link only after address validation; real peer byte windows, sequence, RTT/retransmission and one-sided reset prevent unbounded send/ping-pong.
Validate exact target/queue challenge signature purpose35, echo origin time, bound validity/RTT and refresh; an unvalidated queue alone cannot announce a usable CORE link.
Fragment offsets/total/messageUUID identify assembly; ACK UUID is unique per transmission attempt and duplicate fragments get immediate ACK without duplicate delivery.
Match ACK by authenticated sender+UUID across queues; cumulative counter/delay, retransmission, Karn/RTT and duplicate suppression affect actual original work once.

Preserve header4 + one complete inner frame + NUL communicator prefix and the actual carrier sender identity; route over a confirmed virtual link or neighbour and deliver only to the registered matching communicator. Cryptographic/replay protection belongs to the inner communicator/carrier or enclosing DV box, not invented1213 fields.
required_cases: wrong or unterminated prefix and malformed inner
actual inner communicator and carrier auth/replay profile

operations.contract: Validate initiator purpose37 and each hop purpose36, path bounds/duplicates and persistent monotime; route learning/cancel prevents replay amplification.
Actual encrypted DV boxes preserve initiator/target/path/encapsulation, decapsulation lifetime and target-only inner dispatch; intermediate forwarding is bounded.
Per-client peer preferences and strength update routing; cancel only original suggestion and validate/import HELLO without accepting stale async peer results.
required_cases: normal lib application helper actual suggest
one peer cannot trigger unrelated HELLO

operations.contract: Monitor snapshot/continuous modes and peer filters remain external capabilities; link list actual end marker and confirmed/unconfirmed filter are exact. MONITOR_END is accepted by normal library but no emitter found in pinned service; preserve discrepancy.
required_cases: normal public one-shot and continuous profile

operations.contract: NAT burst synchronization updates concrete original queue readiness; failure/shutdown retires only original burst and backpressure cannot spin.
Real byte-stream initial handshake, cryptographic derivation and first FINISH use the official layout even though the initial bytes have no GNUnet message-header registry assignment.
Authenticated frame lengths, key confirmation/rekey and replay histories remain per original session, with real IO fairness and no false local progress.
required_cases: normal C twopeers data and rekeys
partial future cancellation and owned shutdown

operations.contract: NAT probes are distinguished from cryptographic traffic and use canonical intended remote/local address without fabricating validated CORE links.
UDP datagram initial KX/backchannel/MTU/ack/rekey and address semantics remain required additional transport profile; TCP success grants no UDP credit.
required_cases: real normal C UDP mixed peers

operations.contract: Current UNIX/QUIC/HTTP3/libp2p communicator protocol and configuration capabilities stay separate explicit profiles; absence from the selected TCP node proof cannot remove them from overall full implementation.
required_cases: actual normal C mixed-peer profile per protocol
explicit unavailable dependency gap without success credit

profiles.note: Node-path receipt alone is still not full overall GNUnet or all TRANSPORT profiles. Separate DV/backchannel/reliability/fragment cases require deliberate route/MTU/loss setup.
